Home.featuresTitle: Built so you can check everything
Home.featuresBody: Every topic, score and question traces back to your files.
Home.feature1Body: Open any topic to see the quote, file, page and heading behind it. Unsupported topics are flagged, not guessed.
Home.feature1Point2: Page and heading on every citation
Home.feature2Body: Past-paper questions are matched to your approved topics by marks and year, so frequently examined topics rank higher.
Home.feature2Point1: Marks and years read from the paper
Home.feature2Point2: A stated reason for every score
Home.feature3Title: Track every file as it's processed
Home.feature3Body: Watch each upload move from checking to reading to indexing. If a file fails, you get the reason and a one-click retry.
Home.darkBody: GapFinder is built so one student can never see another's workspace — enforced in the app and again in the database.
Home.dark1Body: Every request is checked against your account and workspace.
Home.dark2Body: Files are never public; previews use links that expire in a minute.
Home.dark3Body: Deleting a workspace removes its files, text and topics.
Home.dark4Body: AI output is checked against your files before you ever see it.

Home.faq1A: To keep GapFinder available for everyone, each student has transparent daily limits: 10 diagnostics or re-tests, 20 explanations, 10 voice requests and 10 illustrations.
Home.faq2A: Plain text (.txt), Word (.docx) and PDF — including scanned PDFs, which are read with OCR. Each file can be up to 50 MB.
Home.faq3Q: Does GapFinder use knowledge from the internet?
Home.faq3A: No. Topics, questions, marking and explanations come only from the files in your workspace, with exact quotes. When your files don't support something, GapFinder tells you instead of filling the gap.
Home.faq4A: The interface is available in English, Hindi, Punjabi, Telugu and Dakhni (Latin script). Your materials can be in English, Hindi, Punjabi or Telugu; original quotes are always shown, with labelled translations when needed.
Home.faq5A: Only you. Workspaces are private to your account and files are stored privately. Deleting a workspace deletes its files and everything derived from them, and you can delete your whole account at any time.
Home.ctaBody: Create an account and upload your syllabus to get started.
Home.step7Body: Weak, Medium or Strong per unit, with reasons and sources.
Home.step8Body: Weak, important units first — honest if time is short.
Home.step9Body: Each re-test adds a new report version, so progress is clear.
Home.tour7Body: Labels, reasons, importance and the questions you missed — each with its source.
Home.tour8Body: Day-by-day sessions from your report and availability, with any shortfall shown honestly.
Home.tour9Body: Mastery by unit across report versions, as a chart or a table.
Home.step10Body: Type or speak; answers quote only your own files.
Home.tour10Body: A grounded answer with its sources, a Listen button and an illustration labelled as AI-made.
Home.feature4Title: Diagnostics written from your own notes
Home.feature4Body: Pick 5, 10 or 15 questions, timed or untimed. Multiple-choice is marked by fixed rules, written answers against a hidden rubric.
Home.feature4Point3: Review shows answer, criteria and source
Home.feature5Title: A Gap Report and a plan that tell the truth
Home.feature5Body: Units are ranked by gap and exam importance, then turned into daily sessions. If time is short, the plan says so.
Home.feature5Point3: Re-test gaps and watch mastery change
Home.feature6Body: Ask by typing or speaking. Answers use only your files and show their quotes, with read-aloud and your textbook's own figures.
Home.feature6Point1: Says so when your files aren't enough
Home.feature6Point2: Voice in English, Hindi, Punjabi, Telugu
Home.faq6Q: Can I try it without uploading anything?
Home.faq6A: Yes. Sign up and open the demo workspace: sample Class 10 Science notes, a syllabus and a practice paper written for GapFinder, ready for diagnostics, reports, plans and Explain. It is a private copy in your own account.
Home.faq7Q: Are the illustrations and voice answers reliable?
Home.faq7A: The written answer and its quotes are the source of truth. Voice reads that answer aloud. Illustrations are drawn only from facts in your cited sources, labelled as AI-generated, and never counted as a source; when your PDF has its own figure, GapFinder shows that instead.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: GapFinder AI is a study tool for students. This policy explains what we collect, why, who processes it and how you delete it.
Privacy.s1Body: Your email address and password (handled by our authentication provider), your language choice, the study workspaces you create, the files you upload, the text extracted from them, the topic maps you build, and technical logs needed to run and secure the service.
Privacy.s2Body: Only to provide GapFinder to you: to store your materials, build your topic maps, show citations, and keep the service secure and within fair-use limits. We do not sell your data, show advertising, or use your files to train AI models.
Privacy.s3Body: Supabase stores your account, database records and files. Groq processes short excerpts of your own material to propose topics, read past papers, write and mark diagnostic questions, explain topics and translate citations. ElevenLabs turns your spoken Explain questions into text and reads explanations aloud; Cloudflare Workers AI draws illustrations from facts in your cited sources. Text embeddings are computed on our own server. Each processor receives only what the feature needs — never your password.
Privacy.s4Body: Only you can access your workspaces. Files are stored privately and are shown to you through links that expire after one minute. One student can never access another student's workspace.
Privacy.s5Body: Your data stays until you delete it. Deleting a document removes the file and everything derived from it. Deleting a workspace removes all of its files, text, topics and related records.
Privacy.s6Body: You can change your language at any time, delete documents and workspaces, and delete your whole account from the account menu. Account deletion is immediate: your files go first, then every record. If this policy changes in a way that matters, we will ask you to accept the new version.
Privacy.s7Body: Questions about privacy can be sent through the contact details published with the service.
